articles.summary: Hilltop Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HTH) (“Hilltop”) today announced financial results for the fourth quarter and full year 2025. Hilltop produced income attributable to common stockholders of $41.6 million, or $0.69 per diluted share, for the fourth quarter of 2025, compared to $35.5 million, or $0.55 per diluted share, for the fourth quarter of 2024.
